title: Orchard Foods - Phase 2 Kickoff Call
summary: Orchard Foods - Phase 2 Kickoff Call was held on 29 July 2026 with Sana Malik, Ayesha Rauf, Faraz Khan, Bilal Ahmed and Nadia Sheikh. We agreed to lock Phase 2 scope to the loyalty programme and the vendor dashboard, with everything else moved to Phase 3. Real time means we depend on the Orchard till system pushing events to us, and we have no documentation for that API. I'll draft an integration options document covering both real time and batch, so we are not stuck waiting. We also decided to run fortnightly demos with Orchard rather than monthly, starting the week of 10 August. The meeting produced 2 recorded decisions and 5 action items.
